brief: How I manage 3 side hustles & a full-time job — without losing my mind.

slots.title: TIME BLOCK
slots.body: I treat every hustle like a meeting. Calendars don’t lie, and neither do color-coded blocks of deep work.
slots.author: Lily Chen

slots.title: ONE GOAL
slots.body: Each quarter, I pick one priority per hustle. Spreading thin guarantees mediocrity; focus creates momentum.
slots.author: Lily Chen

slots.title: BATCH TASKS
slots.body: I group similar chores—emails, content, invoicing—into single sprints. Context switching is the real thief of time.
slots.author: Lily Chen

slots.title: SUNDAY RESET
slots.body: A ninety-minute prep every Sunday saves me ten hours of weekday chaos. Plan the week before it begins.
slots.author: Lily Chen

slots.title: HARD BOUNDARIES
slots.body: I close my laptop at eight. Burnout doesn’t build empires; rest is the secret weapon of sustainable side hustles.
slots.author: Lily Chen

slots.title: SYSTEMS WIN
slots.body: Templates, automations, and SOPs do the heavy lifting. If it repeats, it gets documented so I can scale.
slots.author: Lily Chen

slots.headline: GO
slots.body: Pick one tip and test it this week. Small systems today, wild freedom tomorrow.
slots.author: Lily Chen
